title: Burchett's 'five to seven undersea bases' claim traced to the email

tellings.quote: what I think happened is someone who'd seen that email is the one who talked to Burchett.

plain: A member of Congress named Tim Burchett has said there are five to seven undersea bases, and a retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet thinks he knows where that came from. Gallaudet says on the show, as his own guess without naming a source, that someone who had seen an email from a naval intelligence commander is the person who talked to Burchett. If so, the claim of hidden bases under the sea would trace back to a message inside the Navy.
